answer: An attacker therefore cannot take the money and run, as most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. The violet schedule is applied in anchor and umber exposes each instalment. A payout is split which means 31% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. A farm of 4568 identities would post 4829 proofs and burn roughly 49 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is an escrow account with a referee holding the key: both sides can claim anything, and only the deposit settles the argument.
